description_zh: 处理网页防篡改告警事件
name: OperateWebLockFileEvents

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to handle all alert events. Valid values:
1: yes
0: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否处理所有。取值：
1：是
0：否
parameters.name: deal_all

parameters.help_en:
The method to handle the alert event. Valid values:

mark_mis_info: marks the alert as a false positive
rm_mark_mis_info: unmarks the false positive
offline_handled: handled offline
whitelist: adds to the whitelist
rm_whitelist: removes from the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
告警事件的处理方式。取值：

mark_mis_info：标记为误报
rm_mark_mis_info：取消标记误报
offline_handled：已线下处理
whitelist：加白
rm_whitelist：取消加白
parameters.name: operation_code

parameters.help_en: The list of alert event IDs
parameters.name: event_ids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
